note: Chart of accounts for a mixed property and trading portfolio. 'tax_treatment' records the default position; it is a prompt for judgement, not a substitute for it. Anything marked 'judgement' must be reviewed by a person each period.

accounts.name: Investment property - improvements
accounts.tax_treatment: capital - adds to CGT base cost

accounts.name: Fixtures and fittings
accounts.tax_treatment: capital - check CAA 2001 s.35 dwelling restriction

accounts.name: Directors loan account - liability side
accounts.tax_treatment: judgement - repayable free of tax if genuinely funded

accounts.name: Dividends declared
accounts.tax_treatment: requires distributable reserves - check before declaring

accounts.name: Rental income - commercial
accounts.tax_treatment: property income; VAT if opted to tax

accounts.name: Rental income - serviced / short let
accounts.tax_treatment: judgement - may be a trade; VAT applies

accounts.name: Service charge income
accounts.tax_treatment: judgement - may be held on trust for tenants

accounts.name: Repairs and maintenance
accounts.tax_treatment: judgement - repair vs improvement is the classic dispute

accounts.name: Ground rent and service charges paid
Legal and professional - revenue
accounts.tax_treatment: judgement - purchase-related legal fees are capital

accounts.name: Legal and professional - capital
accounts.tax_treatment: capital - add to base cost, do not deduct

accounts.name: Accountancy fees
accounts.tax_treatment: allowable - personal tax return element may not be

accounts.name: Mortgage interest - residential (personal)
accounts.tax_treatment: RESTRICTED - s.24 tax reducer only, not a deduction

accounts.name: Motor and travel
accounts.tax_treatment: judgement - property travel is restricted; keep a log

accounts.name: Use of home
accounts.tax_treatment: judgement - apportion on a defensible basis

accounts.name: Employer pension contributions
accounts.tax_treatment: allowable if wholly and exclusively; paid basis

accounts.name: Depreciation
accounts.tax_treatment: DISALLOWABLE - added back, capital allowances instead

accounts.name: Entertaining
accounts.tax_treatment: DISALLOWABLE - client entertaining is never deductible

accounts.name: Charitable donations
accounts.tax_treatment: judgement - relief route differs by entity

accounts.name: SUSPENSE - unclassified
accounts.tax_treatment: MUST BE CLEARED before any report is issued

accounts.name: SUSPENSE - awaiting evidence
accounts.tax_treatment: MUST BE CLEARED - no receipt, no deduction

accounts.name: Inter-entity transfer
accounts.tax_treatment: judgement - must net to nil across the portfolio
